declarations.type: for every positive viscosity, constructs fields with CandidateProperties, excludes a global smooth finite-energy solution for that force and datum, and has zero initial fields on the specified interval

definition_module_note.interpretation: The OPEN docstring says only that this module defines candidateStatement without proving it locally. It does not state that the repository has no proof; the imported assembly and theorem modules above supply proofs.

interpretation_and_limits: A clean checkout of the pinned public source compiles the named declarations and #print axioms reports no sorryAx for them.

This confirms the formal declarations and their Lean elaboration at the pinned revision; it is not an independent review of the mathematical correctness, modeling choices, or validity of the construction.

The theorem concerns the repository's formalized continuum Navier-Stokes proposition. It does not establish molecule ordering, particle-position determinism, a physical phase transition, optical-fluid behavior, or viscosity collapse.

The earlier conclusion that the whole-repository candidateStatement was OPEN was a false negative caused by reading the proposition-definition module in isolation; preserve the prior artifact as historical evidence and use this record as its correction.
reproduction: With Lean 4.34.0-rc2, run: lake build NavierStokes.ActualCandidateAssembly NavierStokes.R3.Theorem.
Run lake env lean on a file importing those modules and applying #print axioms to the declarations listed above.
